slides.text: 5 WhatsApp replies to send the minute an enquiry lands

messages.text: Hi, is the grey sofa still available?
Hi, thanks for messaging. Checking stock for you now.

slides.title: Confirm you saw it
slides.text: Reply inside a minute, even when the full answer takes longer.

data.text: Hi, thanks for messaging Your Shop. I've seen your enquiry and I'm checking it now. I'll reply with details before 6 PM today.
data.when: Send: the moment the enquiry lands

slides.title: Ask one question
slides.text: One clear question keeps the chat moving. A list of questions stalls it.

data.text: Quick question so I send you the right options: is this for your home or your office?
data.when: Send: right after your first reply

slides.title: Answer the price
slides.text: Price is usually the real question. Answer it in the chat so they don't have to call.

data.text: The 3-seater is $[price] and the 2-seater is $[price]. Want photos of both before you decide?
data.when: Send: when they ask what it costs

slides.title: Offer two time slots
slides.text: Two slots to pick from get a faster answer than 'when suits you'.

data.text: I can call you today at 4 PM or tomorrow at 11 AM. Which one suits you?
data.when: Send: once they have seen options

slides.title: Nudge once, next morning
slides.text: If the chat goes quiet, send one short nudge the next day. Then leave it.

data.text: Good morning. Just checking you got the options I sent yesterday. Happy to answer any questions, no rush.

slides.title: Save this for the next enquiry.

slides.text: Five replies, in order. Send the first one inside a minute.
